$comment: System defaults that ship WITH the application. Read-only at runtime: per-machine and per-shop
choices are stored elsewhere (LocalAppData\CameywareOrder and the Shops table respectively),
and nothing in the application writes back to this file.
defaultLanguage is the language a fresh installation starts in, and the fallback used when a
key is missing from the language the user is running. It used to be the `default` attribute on
the <Languages> root of the old single-file table; splitting that file into one document per
language left it without a home, and a per-language file cannot own it — two of them could
each claim to be the default. It must be a value ABOUT the set, so it lives here.
It must name a language that Settings/System/Languages actually ships; if it does not, the
loader falls back to the first language it discovered rather than failing to start.
backupRetentionCount is how many safety copies to keep in LocalAppData\CameywareOrder\Backups.
One is taken automatically before every database import, so without a limit they accumulate
forever — and a Documents backup is a full copy of every attached image, not a small file.
Only ever applied after a NEW backup is written, so nothing is deleted unless it has just been
superseded. Set it to 0 to keep every backup indefinitely.
